## University Database Management System

For this project, my partner and I developed a full-stack university database management system using MySQL, PHP, HTML, and CSS. We designed a relational database schema with normalized tables and implemented SQL queries to manage students, professors, courses, sections, and enrollments. We finished it be building an interactive web application that allows users to view professor teaching schedules, analyze grade distributions, search course sections, and retrieve student academic records through dynamic PHP pages connected to a MySQL database.
